family.note: Fingerprint of createMeter({botVersion:'family-key-memory-v1'}) on wip/cc-builder-loop after merge 8d62405d. Codex rated this bot as d362e85fba3d61523c54bc53a92745458e4467fb4a59624aad1312e9d9003ae3 before the merge with the G2 fast path changed shared sources; the meter does not migrate those cache entries. Key memory has no fast path yet, so it runs the slow path.
family.reusePriorNote: Reading Codex's d362e85f cache entries is off until the lead approves it. Evidence for approval: see priorCheck.

reference.role: counterfactual only (gate C1), and the planner
reference.note: createMeter() default (fast mode). The meter itself migrates the older f3285928 / cae3bc38 / ac24aad8 family cache entries (FAMILY_CACHE_MIGRATIONS, G2 zero-drift).

planner.role: S (skilled), better of route and plain styles (Task 05)
planner.note: Same settings as batch_evaluate.js quality mode, so cached planner ratings are reused.

CURVE.use: every spare of a puzzle, paired (same seeds at every spare)
CURVE.pooling: Production pooling (batch_evaluate.js rate mode, empirical_confirm.js, task11_rerate.js): two meter calls {setting:'family', runs:20, seeds:2} at seed 4711 and seed 18427, 40 campaigns each, pooled = (exp4711 + exp18427) / 2. Production rated the reference bot's 4711 call with capture:'tail' (part of the cache key, not of the rating); Codex rated key memory without capture. The yardstick looks up both cache variants before measuring.
CURVE.visibleCampaigns: The meter returns per-campaign results only for the first sub-block of each call (the first 20 of 40). SEs are therefore estimated from 40 of 80 campaigns (sample SD / sqrt(80)); D itself uses all 80.

ACCEPT.use: the value of record; never reused, never used for choosing
ACCEPT.note: Block j is meter call {runs:20, seeds:2, seed: 29717 + 15838*j}. Its two sub-blocks are 29717 + 7919*(2j) and 29717 + 7919*(2j+1), so blocks never overlap each other or 4711/12630/18427/26346. Block 0 equals production's reserved final seed (final_seed.js SEED = 29717).

steps: If |D - T| > 2.5 x tolerance: refuse the pair for that slot (the puzzle goes back to the library).
Otherwise measure up to 320 campaigns (8 blocks) and accept only if |D - T| <= tolerance.

tolerance.note: The relative part above D 10 is a decision for Dennis (synthesis section 2).
